scope: Descriptive common-root minimumN32 C0 joint GLS sensitivity. September archived anchors remain fixed at original cuts/blocks; only current campaign chains change. Pooled moment weights reflect retained rows under each cut. These checks do not certify archived warmup, mixing, finite-size model adequacy or total uncertainty coverage. Correlated analyses of the same simulations are not independent replication. No adjustment to force the known q1 benchmark.
